posts.text:
He stopped posting about guns in 2022

It was never about policy. 

It was about reelection. 

Instead of pushing any meaningful and constructive policy, he helped ban access to 3D printers from all STEM students in the entire state of New York. 

They had already achieved a 20% reduction in murders before the ban. 

Dexter Taylor is rotting in prison while he lines his pocket with favors. 

And this isn’t unique. 

Follow @loyalmoses to learn more about attacks on accessible home manufacturing
